THE JOURNEY

See the icons.
Then live the city.

The itinerary deliberately changes character halfway through. Wangfujing is the base for Beijing’s imperial core, Mutianyu and modern nightlife. Nanluoguxiang then brings the trip down to street level: hutongs, cafés, lakes, local shopping and evenings around Gulou and Houhai.

Monumental Beijing · photography

China's monumental civic heart

Why you're here

Beijing's vast ceremonial square, framed by Tiananmen Gate, the Great Hall of the People and the National Museum. This is the transition point between modern state Beijing and the imperial city.

DO HERE · See the monumental scale · Photograph Tiananmen Gate · Understand Beijing's central axis

Forbidden CityAMap ↗

Main halls · imperial garden · architecture · history

The imperial palace at the center of Beijing

Why you're here

The former palace of the Ming and Qing emperors: monumental gates, red-walled courtyards, ceremonial halls and the most important imperial architecture in the city.

DO HERE · Walk the central axis · Explore palace courtyards · Imperial Garden · Architecture & history

An imperial garden of lake, willows & the White Pagoda

Why you're here

A former imperial garden immediately northwest of the Forbidden City. Its lake, island and Tibetan-style White Pagoda create one of central Beijing's most distinctive landscapes.

DO HERE · Imperial garden · Lake walk · White Pagoda views · Photography

Local shopping · gifts · snacks

A compact historic shopping lane

Why you're here

A narrow old commercial hutong leading toward Shichahai, lined with traditional-style storefronts, small shops, snacks and souvenirs. It works best as a browse rather than a major sightseeing stop.

DO HERE · Local gifts · Snacks · Browse small shops · Street photography
16:15–17:20

Historic lakes in the heart of old Beijing

A chain of lakes surrounded by hutongs, willow-lined paths, cafés and historic neighbourhoods. Late afternoon is ideal: the water softens the pace before sunset and dinner.
